Transcription.// Notes: Per Voice Live 2025-10-01 spec, only these models are supported with gpt-realtime: whisper-1, gpt-4o-transcribe, gpt-4o-mini-transcribe, gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize. azure-speech is NOT supported with gpt-realtime. gpt-4o-transcribe has lower WER (4.1% vs 5.3% on FLEURS), better noise/accent handling, and is OpenAI's recommended successor. whisper-1 is more stable for very short utterances and the older safe fallback.
